name: Demon
source:
The protagonist, Konstantin, is an exorcist and a demonologist. During an unsuccessful attempt to destroy a demon, the creature possesses him. With the help of the Sovyonok camp, the protagonist and his friend Doc want to imprison the demon there. But what exactly will go wrong?

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2007390875]Steam[/url]]
translation:
主角康斯坦丁是一位驱魔师和恶魔学家。在一次消灭恶魔的尝试失败时，恶魔占据了他。在索维诺克阵营的帮助下，主角和他的朋友Doc想要将恶魔囚禁在那里。但到底会出什么问题呢？

[译自[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2007390875]Steam[/url]]
